svg.title: FitCoach system architecture diagram
svg.desc: Client web app talks to a FastAPI backend, which routes messages to the FitCoach agent orchestrator. The orchestrator calls the Groq LLM API and business-logic tools, which read and write a SQLite database. A background reminder scheduler independently polls and writes to the same database.
svg.text: AI fitness & nutrition coaching platform — tool-calling agent architecture

g.text: • Routes to tools or replies directly
• Polls reminders table on an interval
